draft.weaknessQuote: Smallish frame (measured 5-foot-9, 177 pounds at Tropical Bowl in February).
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.18, the 254th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 27th of 27 at CB. He went 223rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (254th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 passes defended in 2019, 27th of 27 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 46 career games and 6 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2020. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), season snap share 4.0% (8th percentile).
